subject: Ephemeral access attestation + SCIM delta & session TTL logs for SIG review
messages:
From: Pat Garcia <pat.garcia@bluespinehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@bluespinehealth.com
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: SIG evidence ask — ephemeral access attestation + SCIM delta logs

Hi Hannah / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our SIG assessment we need a short bundle of artifacts to validate your access and provisioning controls. Can you confirm whether you can provide the following by COB 30 Jun?

1) A short attestation (signed by a responsible owner) describing how ephemeral/just-in-time admin access is provisioned and revoked (typical flow, max TTL values, approval gating).
2) SCIM delta export (sample of account provisioning/deprovisioning events for May 2026) with column descriptions.
3) Session TTL and token revocation logs for non-prod and prod for the last 30 days (redact PII).
4) A mapping of role names to least-privilege descriptions (owners + JIRA ticket where role requests are tracked).

We can accept PDFs/CSVs and a short email attestation. If you have a one-page workback plan that shows delivery owners and dates that would be helpful.

Please let me know if you need more time — we have a SIG gate review the week of 6 Jul, so 30 Jun gives us a day to slot items.

Pat
Pat Garcia
Sr. Security Engineer, BlueSpine Health
pat.garcia@bluespinehealth.com
security@bluespinehealth.com

Attachments: none
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Pat Garcia <pat.garcia@bluespinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence ask — ephemeral access attestation + SCIM delta logs

Pat — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick answers and plan: 

- Attestation: we can provide a signed attestation. Owner: Jonas Weber (Head of Identity & Access).
- SCIM delta export: we can deliver a sample CSV for May 2026. We'll include column descriptions and a short note on delta cadence (async every 5–10 minutes, batched).
- Session TTL / token revocations: we'll export session TTL configuration and a 30-day redacted revocation log for prod and non-prod. Note: revocation events are stored for 90 days; we can produce a 30-day slice.
- Role mapping: we'll attach a role-to-privilege mapping CSV and point to the internal JIRA epic for role requests.

Proposed delivery: see attached workback_plan_ephemeral-access.xlsx — high-level schedule with owners. Key milestones:
  * 2026-06-18: SCIM sample + column mapping (Jonas)
  * 2026-06-22: Session TTL export + revocation log (Infra team / Sean)
  * 2026-06-24: Role mapping + attestation draft (Jonas + Hannah)
  * 2026-06-29: Final signed attestation + consolidated archive delivered to your secure share

If that timeline works I will lock owners. Two quick clarifying Qs: do you need the SCIM export in a specific schema (Okta / Azure AD style) or is a generic delta with attribute names fine? Also confirm who should sign the attestation (technical owner vs. security/compliance lead).

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Security & Compliance (Redwood Inference)
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: workback_plan_ephemeral-access.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Pat Garcia <pat.garcia@bluespinehealth.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence ask — ephemeral access attestation + SCIM delta logs

Pat, Hannah — adding the technical details we'll include with the SCIM/TTL export. See inline: 

- SCIM delta: CSV will include: event_id, timestamp, user_id, external_id, operation (CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE), changed_attributes, actor_id, source (Okta/Azure/Manual). We'll also include a small sample of the raw SCIM patch payloads (redacted).
- Session TTLs: prod default session TTL = 8 hours (interactive), service tokens TTL = 60 minutes, admin JIT sessions default TTL = 15 minutes (extendable with approval).
- Revocation log: we will redact IPs and user email localparts per your request, leaving unique opaque ids and timestamps.
- Role mapping: we will pull canonical role names from the role registry and include the owning team and the linked JIRA EPIC (INFRA-2783).

Attached is a small sample of the SCIM delta extract for May (scim-delta-sample-202605.csv) and a tail of the session log (session-ttl-export-202606.log). Large exports will be delivered via your secure SFTP or our encrypted share.

If BlueSpine needs a different attribute layout, let me know by EOD 18 Jun and we'll adapt the export.

Jonas Weber
Head of Identity & Access, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Attachments: scim-delta-sample-202605.csv (csv); session-ttl-export-202606.log (log)
From: Pat Garcia <pat.garcia@bluespinehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence ask — ephemeral access attestation + SCIM delta logs

Thanks — this is great and the samples look fine. A few closing asks before we mark items accepted: 

1) Could you include the short attestation as a PDF signed (electronic signature) by the Head of Identity (Jonas) and include the date?
2) For the role mapping, please include one example justification ticket for an admin role (the EPIC link is fine).
3) We'll need the final archive uploaded to our secure share (link below) and an MD5 checksum for the archive.

Secure upload: https://bssecure.bluespinehealth.com/drop/BSH-4872

If you can deliver the final archive and attestation by 29 Jun we'll be in good shape for our SIG gate on 6 Jul. Appreciate the quick turn on this.

Pat
Pat Garcia
Sr. Security Engineer, BlueSpine Health
pat.garcia@bluespinehealth.com
